name: hydromancer-mcp

tools.name: hydromancer_wallet_overview
tools.description: One-call profile of any Hyperliquid wallet: account value, every open perp position (side, size, entry, liquidation price, leverage, unrealized PnL), spot balances and its realized trading record (PnL, win rate, trade count, volume, human score). Use this first for questions like "what is this wallet holding?" or "is this trader any good?". Set includeHip3=true to include HIP-3 markets such as xyz:TSLA.

address.description: Wallet address, 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

includeHip3.description: Also include positions on HIP-3 markets (stocks, indices, commodities). Default false.

tools.name: hydromancer_compare_wallets
tools.description: Look up balance, account mode and open positions for up to 1,000 wallets (100 when includeHip3=true), sorted by balance. Handles unified-account and portfolio-margin wallets, whose money sits in spot rather than perps. Use for watchlists: "which of these wallets are whales?", "what do these 50 traders hold?".

items.description: Wallet address, 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

includeHip3.description: Include HIP-3 markets (limit drops to 100 wallets).

minBalanceUsd.description: Only return wallets with at least this balance (see balanceNote on each wallet).

tools.name: hydromancer_wallet_trades
tools.description: Every fill (buy/sell execution) a wallet made in a time window, newest first, with totals: volume, realized PnL, fees and a per-coin breakdown. since/until accept Relative ("30m", "6h", "24h", "7d"), a date ("2026-10-01"), a date-time ("2026-10-01T12:00:00Z"), "now", or Unix ms. Default window: last 24h. Large orders split into many fills are merged by default.

address.description: Wallet address, 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

since.description: Start of window. Relative ("30m", "6h", "24h", "7d"), a date ("2026-10-01"), a date-time ("2026-10-01T12:00:00Z"), "now", or Unix ms. Default "24h".

coin.description: Market name, any case: "BTC", "eth", "HYPE", "kPEPE", or a HIP-3 market such as "xyz:TSLA".

mergeSplitOrders.description: Merge pieces of one order into a single fill (default true).

limit.description: How many rows to return (default 100, max 2000).

tools.name: hydromancer_wallet_closed_trades
tools.description: Completed trades for a wallet: each row is a full position from open to close with entry, exit, size, gross and net PnL, fees, funding and how long it was held. Best tool for judging trading skill ("what is this wallet's win rate and best coin?"). Default window: last 30 days. since/until accept Relative ("30m", "6h", "24h", "7d"), a date ("2026-10-01"), a date-time ("2026-10-01T12:00:00Z"), "now", or Unix ms.

address.description: Wallet address, 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

coin.description: Market name, any case: "BTC", "eth", "HYPE", "kPEPE", or a HIP-3 market such as "xyz:TSLA".

limit.description: How many rows to return (default 100, max 500).

tools.name: hydromancer_wallet_open_orders
tools.description: All resting orders for a wallet right now, including stop-loss and take-profit triggers. Shows where a trader plans to buy, sell or exit.

address.description: Wallet address, 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

tools.name: hydromancer_wallet_transfers
tools.description: Money movements for a wallet: deposits, withdrawals, sends, spot/perp transfers, vault deposits and liquidations. Default window: last 30 days. since/until accept Relative ("30m", "6h", "24h", "7d"), a date ("2026-10-01"), a date-time ("2026-10-01T12:00:00Z"), "now", or Unix ms.

address.description: Wallet address, 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

limit.description: How many rows to return (default 100, max 2000).

tools.name: hydromancer_wallet_funding
tools.description: Funding paid or received by a wallet's open positions, hour by hour, with totals per coin. Positive = received, negative = paid. Default window: last 7 days.

address.description: Wallet address, 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

tools.name: hydromancer_top_traders
tools.description: Rank Hyperliquid traders by realized profit, win rate or volume over 1 day to all time, with filters that remove bots and one-off wallets. Use for "who are the best traders this week?", "find consistent winners on stocks (dex xyz)" or "top traders using builder X". Pair with hydromancer_wallet_overview to see what they hold now.

limit.description: How many rows to return (default 25, max 1000).

excludeBots.description: Drop wallets that look automated (human score below 60). Default true.

market.description: Only "main" (native Hyperliquid) or a HIP-3 dex such as "xyz". Omit for all.

builder.description: Only traders who have traded through this builder's app.

tools.name: hydromancer_market_snapshot
tools.description: Current mark/oracle/mid price, 24h volume and open interest (in coins and USD) for one or more markets. The top-markets list also shows max leverage. Leave coins empty for the top markets by 24h volume. Works for HIP-3 markets (e.g. "xyz:TSLA").

coins.description: Markets to show, e.g. ["BTC","ETH","xyz:TSLA"]. Omit for the busiest markets.

top.description: When coins is empty, how many top markets by 24h volume (default 15).

tools.name: hydromancer_price_history
tools.description: Price history as candles (open, high, low, close, volume) for any market. Intervals from 1 second to 1 month. Default: 1h candles for the last 24h. since/until accept Relative ("30m", "6h", "24h", "7d"), a date ("2026-10-01"), a date-time ("2026-10-01T12:00:00Z"), "now", or Unix ms.

coin.description: Market name, any case: "BTC", "eth", "HYPE", "kPEPE", or a HIP-3 market such as "xyz:TSLA".

interval.description: Candle size (default "1h"). "1s" only covers about the last 30 minutes.

tools.name: hydromancer_funding_history
tools.description: Hourly funding rates for a market over time, with the average and annualized rate. Positive funding means longs pay shorts. Default window: last 7 days.

coin.description: Market name, any case: "BTC", "eth", "HYPE", "kPEPE", or a HIP-3 market such as "xyz:TSLA".

tools.name: hydromancer_open_interest_history
tools.description: How open interest (total open positions) in a market changed over time, in coins and USD. Rising OI with rising price usually means new longs; falling OI means positions are closing. Default: hourly for the last 24h.

coin.description: Market name, any case: "BTC", "eth", "HYPE", "kPEPE", or a HIP-3 market such as "xyz:TSLA".

tools.name: hydromancer_recent_liquidations
tools.description: Positions that were force-closed (liquidated), newest first, for one market or the whole exchange, with totals by side. "Long liquidated" means a long position was wiped out. Default window: last 24h.

coin.description: Market to check; omit for every market.

limit.description: How many rows to return (default 50, max 1000).

tools.name: hydromancer_market_depth
tools.description: How much can be bought or sold near the current price. Returns USD depth on each side within 0.1% to 2% of the price for a market, plus the expected slippage for a market order of a given size over time.

coin.description: Market name, any case: "BTC", "eth", "HYPE", "kPEPE", or a HIP-3 market such as "xyz:TSLA".

orderSizeUsd.description: Order size for the slippage estimate, in USD (default 100,000).

tools.name: hydromancer_list_markets
tools.description: Lists every tradable perp market, optionally filtered by search text or category (crypto, stocks, indices, commodities, fx), plus the HIP-3 exchanges (perp DEXs) that list stocks and other assets. Use when unsure of a market's exact name.

limit.description: How many rows to return (default 100, max 2000).

tools.name: hydromancer_builder_activity
tools.description: Fills routed through a builder (a trading app such as MetaMask, Phantom or a Telegram bot) by its builder address, with volume, builder fees earned, unique traders and top coins. Default window: last 1h (busy builders produce thousands of fills). since/until accept Relative ("30m", "6h", "24h", "7d"), a date ("2026-10-01"), a date-time ("2026-10-01T12:00:00Z"), "now", or Unix ms.

limit.description: How many rows to return (default 25, max 2000).

tools.name: hydromancer_prediction_markets
tools.description: Settled Hyperliquid prediction markets (HIP-4 outcomes) with their result and trading stats, searchable by text, underlying asset or category.

limit.description: How many rows to return (default 20, max 100).

tools.name: hydromancer_my_usage
tools.description: Your own Hydromancer API usage by day and request type: requests, failures, speed and billable tokens. Use to check how much of your plan you are using.

tools.name: hydromancer_raw_request
tools.description: Send any Hydromancer /info request directly, for endpoints the other tools do not cover (e.g. vaultSummaries, historicalOrders, spotMeta, outcomeMeta, delegations, perpDexStatus). Pass the request body as JSON including "type". Full list: https://docs.hydromancer.xyz/llms.txt . Read-only: this server never places orders.

limit.description: How many rows to return (default 200, max 5000).

instructions: Read-only Hyperliquid data from the Hydromancer API: wallets (positions, trades, closed trades, orders, transfers, funding), top-trader leaderboards with bot filters, live market stats, candles, funding, open interest, liquidations, order-book depth, builder app activity and prediction markets. Start with hydromancer_wallet_overview for a wallet, hydromancer_top_traders for "who is winning", hydromancer_market_snapshot for prices. Times accept "24h"/"7d" or dates. Never places trades.
